what: A roots reggae groovebox, in development: a band you play, not a bank of riddims. Version 0.1 brings its own identity, saves and screens (a dub plate boot, a sound system HOME); the synthesized roots band, the drum styles and the dub desk (spring, tape echo, throws, VERSION) are coming.
author: saulofilho
